name: Martín Ezequiel Fernández
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Senior Data Engineer with 8 years of experience designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and ETL processes for analytics and machine learning use cases. Skilled in building robust orchestration workflows with Airflow, optimizing SQL-based data warehouses, and leading migrations to cloud data platforms. Strong background in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable data infrastructure.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Airflow DAGs orchestrating ingestion pipelines from multiple sources
Lead migration of on-premise ETL jobs to AWS-based data lake architecture
Collaborate with data science teams to build feature pipelines for ML models
Optimize SQL queries and warehouse schemas to improve report performance
Mentor two junior data engineers on best practices and code reviews
Built and maintained batch ETL pipelines using Python and SQL
Implemented monitoring and alerting for data pipeline failures
Developed data models to support BI dashboards and reporting
Worked with Kafka to process near real-time event streams
Assisted in developing ETL scripts for internal reporting systems
Wrote and optimized SQL queries for data extraction and transformation
Supported database maintenance tasks and data quality checks
